== Walkthrough ==

''Karg IceBear wanders the tundra, often passing by the North Tower.''

You say, 'Hail, Karg IceBear'

: Karg IceBear says 'Hail, traveler! I am Karg of Clan IceBear, lone hunter of the Everfrost Peaks.  Have you seen any polar bears about?'

You say, 'I have slain a werewolf.'

: Karg IceBear says 'Werewolf?!  I have not seen a werewolf in years.  Have you slain one and collected its skin or its claws?'

You say, 'I have its claws.'

: Karg IceBear says 'Oh, a werewolf claw? If you were to give me the claw and 75 platinum, I could craft excellent gauntlets.'

'''Hand in Werewolf Claws and 75 pp for your reward.'''

''Need hand-in dialogues, faction hits if any.''
